title: Tinashe Says Her Express Collab Features Outfits She’d ‘Actually Hang Out In’
summary: The singer made sure she could dance in the 'fits.
contentText:

Tinashe is fully embracing her Popstar era and bringing that same confidence to her latest collaboration with Express . Ahead of the release of her new album, Popstar , on Sept. 25, the singer teamed up with the fashion retailer for their “Too Easy to Look This Good” campaign. Inspired by her 2026 single Too Easy , the collection features XS-XL sizes and complements Tinashe’s own sartorial choices. “My style encompasses a lot of different feelings, whether that be bold and bad bitch or cool, laid-back sporty,” she told me. This isn’t the first time Tinashe has partnered with a clothing brand. In 2025, the singer’s Urban Outfitters collection sold out most of its pieces shortly after they dropped.

For Tinashe, collaborating with a brand that treats her as a creative partner rather than just the face of a campaign was important, and exactly what she got with the Express collection. “I really wanted it to feel real and something I would actually hang out in,” she said. As a dancer, she also knows the right outfit can elevate a performance just as easily as the wrong one can hold it back. That’s why movement was top of her mind while developing this collab, saying, “When I’m choosing what I wear, something that I can move in and that accentuates my movement is just so important. I was really cognizant of that when I was putting these outfits together for this campaign.”

JEANS

Mid Rise Bootcut Light Wash Jeans in Hyper Stretch

Tinashe’s favorite piece from the collection, this pair of jeans was styled on the singer by folding down the waistband. “They were very comfortable, and they were easy to move in,” she said.

Designed with a flattering mid-rise waist, these light wash bootcut jeans are fitted through the hip, thigh and knee before opening into a subtle flare. Hyper stretch compression denim minimizes waist gapping while maintaining its shape wear after wear. Available in eight colors and three lengths.

DRESS

Satin Cowl Neck Sleeveless Maxi Slip Dress

$98.00

As seen on Tinashe in Express’ campaign video .

This satin maxi slip dress features a draped cowl neckline, adjustable straps and a flattering bias cut that skims the body. A side leg slit adds movement while the pull-on design creates an effortless silhouette suited for weddings, parties or evening events.

TOP

Satin Leopard Lace Trim V-Neck Wide Strap Cami

$48.00

Tinashe posed in the mirror during a montage of outfit changes in this satin leopard print cami.

The top features an allover print with delicate lace trim along the neckline, and the flattering V-neck front and back are balanced by wide straps for added comfort. Pair it with the matching bottoms or style it with denim for an elevated everyday look.

PANTS

Faux Leather High Waisted Wide Leg Pant

Available in short, regular and long lengths.

These high-waisted faux leather pants feature a relaxed wide-leg silhouette with classic five-pocket styling and a zipper and button closure. They pair easily with sweaters, blouses or heels for polished seasonal outfits.

BLOUSE

Leopard Portofino Shirt

Limited Time Offer

$39.00 $50.00 22% off

Modeled by Tinashe for the fall “Too Easy to Look This Good” Express campaign.

The classic portofino shirt gets an update with a bold leopard print that transitions easily from workdays to weekends. Designed with a lightweight feel and an effortless silhouette, it pairs well with denim trousers or skirts for versatile styling throughout the season.

Express’ “Too Easy to Look This Good” collection also features Cincinnati Bengals wide receiver Tee Higgins wearing the brand’s latest styles for men . In a campaign video promoting the clothing line, the pro footballer can be seen dancing at a house party and checking out Tinashe’s outfits as she walks by.

Soundtracked to Too Easy , the first single from her new album, Express’ campaign video opens with Tinashe DJing in a black bomber jacket before moving through the party in a pair of folded-down jeans and a lace top. Guests at the party, including Higgins, show off more pieces from the collection before Tinashe changes through five different outfits in front of a mirror and closes the video with a dance break.

View this post on Instagram

The song Too Easy offers a sarcastic take on the pressures that come with fame. Asked whether being a pop star really is “too easy,” Tinashe says she takes the bad with the good. “I genuinely enjoy the highs, the lows, the struggle, the bad, the good, the ugly. I really genuinely love it and enjoy all of it.”

The Express collaboration arrives ahead of Tinashe’s Sept. 25 release of Popstar , her first full-length album since 2024’s Quantum Baby . Fans have already heard two songs from the upcoming 16-track project, which she describes as “unapologetic, bold, and playful.” The release follows two consecutive summers of viral success. Nasty became one of 2024’s breakout hits, reaching No. 69 on the Billboard Hot 100 , while the Disco Lines remix of No Broke Boys topped Billboard’s Hot Dance/Electronic Songs chart in 2025, cementing Tinashe’s momentum heading into her next chapter.
